author: rdc-rfc1-author-c (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: Both handshake sides reset from one rst_ni with equal phases and release through per-domain synchronisers; a request issued before the receiver releases persists until it is acknowledged.

author_reading.rationale: Both handshake sides leave reset together from one root, so the request and acknowledge phases start equal and the first toggle is accepted.

labels.rationale: Both sides are reset from rst_ni through 2-stage synchronisers, so the assertion source is shared and the handshake restarts consistently. The reset release-order obligation is recorded by RDC-023 but the structure is correct.

A common assertion source clears both handshake phases to zero. A first request persists until the receiving side observes it and returns its acknowledgement, so release order does not lose that request.
labels.suspected_flaw: The header says the domains leave reset together, but the independent clocked chains may finish at different times.
